management.errorText: Este dispositivo saiu da descoberta. Atualize a busca antes de solicitar o vínculo.

sourceCause: BonjourDiscoveryPort.rebuildCandidates calls candidateFromService on each sweep; candidateFromService creates a random candidateId, and rebuildCandidates overwrites the map entry every time. The UI can submit the prior snapshot's candidateId while Main's current snapshot already contains a new ID for the same live service target.
classification: Confirmed discovery-handle race in application code. No pairing authority was created; candidate identity remains only an unverified locator.
